cases.name: before has no capability or host commands; old standard v2 entry remains usable
new server advertises additive capability and snapshots still parse in the old client
non-host players cannot remove or transfer; neither command mutates the lobby
self, missing, malformed and foreign targets are rejected without changing readiness or host
missing, stale, fractional, negative and cross-room generation metadata is rejected
host transfer reaches all three sockets and retains loaded/ready state
former host immediately loses control and the new host can start normally
kick explicitly notifies, closes normally, revokes resume, and permits a fresh manual join
an offline player can be removed and receives an explicit removal error on resume
legacy client left handler clears its saved identity and stops automatic reconnect
stale actions from another room cannot apply even when both rooms use lobby generation one
map changes retire old management confirmations even without a race
management commands are rejected throughout countdown, racing and results
a rematch retires the prior lobby generation even on the same map and room code
automatic host election advances the lobby generation and resumed former hosts do not steal it
resuming when every socket was offline elects a connected host in a new generation
removed identity memory is bounded and discarded tombstones still cannot resume
snapshots expose neither revoked IDs nor resume tokens, and core files remain unchanged

limitations: Real local WebSocket transport and RoomService; deterministic private server clock/phase setup, not human driving or public-network timing.
Legacy client runs its real parser/left handler in an isolated VM with test sessionStorage; actual player storage is never accessed.
A maximum of 64 removed player IDs is retained per room; older revoked identities still fail INVALID_SESSION and cannot resume.

tools/dev-tests/lobbybrake-client-result.transport: isolated sockets; true current/before client implementations

cases.name: before has no host methods; current client accepts an old server omitting the capability

host methods send the exact current room/target/generation without creating another socket
non-host and every active/result phase reject management locally
self/missing targets are rejected; offline players can be removed but cannot receive host control
a disconnected transport cannot send management using its cached lobby
lower lobby generations are ignored even with newer times; before would accept the stale host
same-generation readiness updates work and a higher generation immediately revokes former host buttons
map changes keep their existing snapshot reset and also bind management to the newest generation
matching kicked notification clears identity/timers, does not send leave, and never automatically resumes
foreign or incomplete kicked notifications cannot clear the current room/session
metadata-free old left notifications retain the established compatibility cleanup
offline REMOVED_BY_HOST resume rejection clears credentials and stops the ten-second reconnect loop
after a kick only an explicit manual join creates a new connection; malformed capability fails closed

limitations: Runs the real client parser, public methods and lifecycle with isolated socket/sessionStorage and virtual timers; not a browser or real-network test.
Server authorization, real loopback WebSockets and revoked identity behavior are covered separately by lobbybrake-host.mjs.

cases.name: fresh dry medium/soft keep original target values and never share writable physics storage
real RaceField supplies the complete grip factor once: dry/wet/worn/rain tyres
grip decrease cannot increase any display target; physics target array remains byte-identical
speed units and tyre factor are applied once in the lateral-force equation
backward braking propagation crosses the start line and honours original longitudinal deceleration
4Hz limit, conservative one-percent bins, stable buffers and immediate non-GP restoration
new session reset/new track cannot inherit old wet targets or throttle timestamp
invalid inputs remain finite and fall back without corrupting track data
car/track/AI/pitlane/physics files exactly match immutable before

limitations: Uses the real RaceField tyre/wetness/wear formula and real track data; cars/models are isolated CPU objects.
Display profile is a conservative centre-line estimate, not a measured guarantee of cornering/braking safety or lap-time improvement.
No build, browser, GPU, phone or public-site test is run by this script.

cases.name: before/after dry and non-GP ribbon colors/positions/UVs are exactly identical
real main uses one complete GP grip factor and issues an earlier warning than immutable before
wet/worn updates change real world colors in place, preserve geometry attributes and obey 4Hz
GP to TT/qualifying/free/replay and disabling assist restore original colors and thresholds
driver braking/pit suppress warning; wrong-way warning retains precedence
new-race and season restore call cache reset; reset recomputes despite old throttling epoch
world invalid/mismatched targets fall back to original valid vertex colors
BOT target source and core update sequence remain the original ones

limitations: Real source functions and warning branch are extracted by AST; the full main module/DOM/audio is not booted.
Real ribbon and Three.js geometry/color attributes are executed on CPU, without GPU rendering or mobile visual verification.
Grip inputs and vehicle positions are arranged fixtures; this does not measure driving safety, lap times, FPS or phone performance.
